status: implemented validation rules; not Confirmed production military parameters
world_clock: TaxSimulation single tick and transaction; MessageFlow advances before military receipt/effect; tax causal processing retained
save: normal v5 Officers optional Military schema1 extension; legacy FieldBattle retained; simultaneous old and new field models rejected
identity: army owner organization, army commander, unit commander, grant actor and tactical exercise hostility are separate IDs; no political allegiance changes
authority: actor/unit/army/action/jurisdiction/basis/[from,until), checked at dispatch and receipt/effect; commander replacement does not invent grants
transport: existing shared MessageFlow envelopes/attempts/receipts/personal knowledge/failure reports/retry/late arrivals; no separate delivery simulator
deadline: inclusive command-start deadline, not destination-arrival deadline
cancel: delivered to recipient and personally learned, then effective at specified tick; cancellations precede their target; prior movement/losses are not rolled back
idempotency: one logical command across retries/original; shared formal receipt and applied ledger; payload reuse conflicts rejected

intelligence.report: immutable learned source snapshot sent through MessageFlow; observed and learned times distinct
intelligence.stale: dated memory marker at reported cell, never live hidden position/stats/commander
intelligence.clearing: sight of an empty known cell or delivered absence report; unseen enemy retreat does not globally clear memory

map.movement: 4-neighbour stable weighted Dijkstra; no hidden-enemy-aware routes
map.collision: simultaneous same-cell/swap conflicts wait; no arbitrary first unit wins

combat.scenario: two opposing exercise armies using existing officers; not a political war
combat.initiation: explicit Advance consent plus explicit hostility relation and direct sight/contact
combat.npc: scripted willingness and explicit opponent input; no omniscient target pursuit
